procurement_commitment_source_read: Read by Luma from a supplier message
procurement_commitment_source_recorded: Recorded by hand from a supplier message
procurement_error_unavailable: Luma couldn’t load procurement. Try again.
procurement_error_unconfirmed: Luma couldn’t confirm the result. Check your connection and try again.
procurement_lines_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} line} other {{count, number} lines}}
procurement_to_answer: {count, plural, one {{count, number} to answer} other {{count, number} to answer}}
procurement_overview_description: Which orders are drafted, sent, confirmed by the supplier or received, and which need a response.
procurement_overview_attention_label: Show orders that need a response
procurement_overview_waiting_label: Show orders waiting for the supplier to confirm
procurement_list_search_orders_placehold: Search by reference, supplier or SKU…
procurement_list_orders_empty_body: Add a supplier, then create a draft order. You can follow each order here until the goods arrive.
procurement_list_no_permission: Your role can’t create purchase orders. Ask a workspace admin for access.
procurement_list_suppliers_empty_body: Start with the supplier’s name. Add a reference if the supplier also exists in another system.
procurement_list_orders_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} purchase order} other {{count, number} purchase orders}}
procurement_list_suppliers_pagination_to: {count, plural, one {{count, number} supplier} other {{count, number} suppliers}}
procurement_form_reference_description: The ID of this record in another system, such as JTL-Wawi.
procurement_supplier_dialog_description: Add a supplier you order from. You can link it to your purchasing system afterward.
procurement_order_dialog_description: Luma saves this as a draft. Nothing goes to the supplier until you send it.
procurement_transition_open_description: {order}: {from} → {to}. This marks the order as open in Luma. It doesn’t send it to the supplier.
procurement_transition_final_description: {order}: {from} → {to}. This is a final status. The order and its history stay available.
procurement_supplier_linked_generic: Linked to {supplier} in your purchasing system.
procurement_supplier_unlinked: Not linked to a purchasing system. Luma tracks this supplier’s orders here only.
procurement_supplier_confirmation_window: {hours, plural, one {Confirmation expected within {hours, number} hour} other {Confirmation expected within {hours, number} hours}}
procurement_supplier_missing_body: This supplier doesn’t exist in this workspace or was removed.
procurement_supplier_orders_empty: No purchase orders with this supplier yet.
procurement_supplier_cannot_send: Luma can’t send purchase orders through this connection. Reconnect it with purchase order access.
procurement_supplied_truncated: Showing the {count, number} most recently ordered SKUs
procurement_supplied_empty: Items appear here once they’re on a purchase order with this supplier.
procurement_supplied_note: “On order” counts draft and open purchase orders. It isn’t confirmed incoming stock.
procurement_detail_check_updates_title: Check {system} now for confirmations and goods receipts
procurement_detail_check_updates_title_g: Check your purchasing system now for confirmations and goods receipts
procurement_detail_offline: You’re offline. Reconnect to refresh this order.
procurement_detail_missing_body: This purchase order doesn’t exist in this workspace or was removed.
procurement_detail_refresh_failed: Luma couldn’t refresh this order. The details below may be out of date.
procurement_next_attention_read: Luma read this from a supplier message. Review it below.
procurement_lines_caption: Lines with supplier commitments and stock
procurement_lines_other_orders: {count, plural, one {Also on {count, number} other order} other {Also on {count, number} other orders}}
procurement_lines_note: Received shows only what your purchasing system booked as received. Stock is shown per source and location, without adding sources together.
procurement_messages_manual_reason: {reason} Select words in a message to record what the supplier committed to.
procurement_messages_manual: Luma can’t read messages automatically in this workspace. Select words in a message to record what the supplier committed to.
procurement_messages_empty: No supplier messages yet. Add the supplier’s order confirmation or delivery notice to track what they committed to.
procurement_message_read_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} commitment found} other {{count, number} commitments found}}
procurement_message_purged_retention: Message text removed after the retention period. Recorded commitments remain.
procurement_message_purged_request: Message text removed on request. Recorded commitments remain.
procurement_message_unrelated: This message may not be about {order}. Luma holds what it found for your review.
procurement_message_retention: Luma keeps the text until {date}, then removes it.
procurement_history_count: {count, plural, one {{count, number} recorded} other {{count, number} recorded}}
procurement_history_empty: No supplier commitments yet. They appear when the supplier confirms the order in your purchasing system or in a message.
procurement_hours: {hours, plural, one {{hours, number} hour} other {{hours, number} hours}}
procurement_issues_empty: No issues for these SKUs or their stock.
procurement_order_card_close_note: Closing marks the order as complete in Luma. It doesn’t cancel the order in your purchasing system.
procurement_review_missing: This purchase order was removed, or you no longer have access to it.
procurement_submit_description: Once approved under the workspace rules, Luma sends this order to {system} once and then checks that it arrived. {system} passes it on to {supplier}.
procurement_submit_description_generic: Once approved under the workspace rules, Luma sends this order to your purchasing system once and then checks that it arrived. Your purchasing system passes it on to {supplier}.
procurement_submit_prices: Recorded prices are estimates from supplier terms. {system} determines the final supplier prices and tax.
procurement_submit_prices_generic: Recorded prices are estimates from supplier terms. Your purchasing system determines the final supplier prices and tax.
procurement_message_dialog_description_r: Paste what the supplier wrote. Luma lists each commitment with the words it came from. Changes and unclear wording wait for your review.
procurement_message_dialog_description_m: Paste what the supplier wrote. Then select the words that state a commitment to record it. Luma can’t read messages automatically in this workspace.
procurement_message_dialog_id_descriptio: The email’s Message-ID header. If you add the same email again, Luma recognizes it and keeps one copy.
procurement_commitment_dialog_correct_de: Luma adds the correction to the history. The original stays visible.
procurement_commitment_dialog_record_des: Luma records this as the supplier’s commitment, quoting the words you selected.
procurement_commitment_dialog_reason_pla: e.g. The supplier corrected the date by phone
procurement_respond_accept_hint: Luma expects the changed quantity or date from now on.
procurement_respond_follow_up_hint: Luma checks again on the date you choose.
procurement_respond_note_placeholder: e.g. Partial delivery is fine for this week
procurement_respond_action_placeholder: e.g. Emailed the supplier for a new date
procurement_respond_check_again_hint: If nothing changes by {date}, the order returns to Needs you.
procurement_link_description: Link this supplier to the same supplier in your purchasing system. Luma can then send approved purchase orders and read confirmations and goods receipts.
procurement_link_no_connection: None of your connections can list suppliers yet. In Apps, connect your purchasing system, such as JTL-Wawi, with access to suppliers and purchase orders.
procurement_link_email: Your purchasing system sends orders to {email}.
procurement_link_hours_hint: After this time, an unconfirmed order appears in Needs you.
procurement_receipt_description: Record total quantities received so far. Earlier records stay in the timeline. This evidence does not verify available stock.
procurement_receipt_damage_hint: Damaged units are excluded from goods available for stock booking.
procurement_receipt_evidence_hint: Add a delivery-note reference, supplier message or photo link, one per line.
procurement_receipt_credited_hint: Record a supplier credit for this difference.
procurement_receipt_written_off_hint: Accept the loss with a reason.
procurement_terms_note: Missing terms stay unknown. Your overrides are kept separately from purchasing-system reads.
procurement_terms_unavailable: Purchasing terms could not be loaded.
procurement_terms_empty: No purchasing terms are recorded yet.
procurement_terms_edit_note: Choose one term and give a reason. Leave the value empty to record it as missing. Previous values remain in history.
procurement_terms_save_failed: This change could not be saved. Retry the same request, or close and refresh if the terms have changed.
procurement_terms_invalid: Choose a supplier and product, then enter a valid value and reason.
procurement_shortfall_title: Order the remainder from another supplier
procurement_shortfall_no_supplier: No alternative supplier terms or receiving location are available for this product. Add the missing terms before proposing an order.
procurement_shortfall_cover: Estimated cover after arrival: {days} days, using the selected location and current demand assumption.
procurement_shortfall_cover_unknown: Days of cover are unknown because current stock or demand evidence is missing.
procurement_shortfall_customer_unknown: Customer-order impact requires allocation evidence. Luma does not assume which customer orders depend on this receipt.
procurement_shortfall_proposed: The purchasing plan is saved. Review its approval and verification in Purchasing. The original difference stays open until the draft is independently verified.
procurement_email_unavailable: Supplier email is unavailable. Check your Inbox access and try again.
procurement_email_description: Review and approve supplier mail in the Operations Inbox. Verified email acceptance does not mean the supplier confirmed the order.
procurement_email_connect: Connect an Operations Inbox with permission to send in Apps. Manual follow-ups remain available.
procurement_email_sent: Email accepted and independently verified. Supplier confirmation is a separate milestone.
procurement_email_failed: Email delivery failed. Check the address and review a new submission.
procurement_email_uncertain: Luma can’t tell whether the supplier received this email and won’t send it again on its own.
procurement_email_review: Review the draft or send status in the Operations Inbox.
procurement_email_empty: No supplier emails drafted for this order.
procurement_email_draft_hint: This creates a draft. Review the text and PDF in the Inbox, then request approval. If needed, a supplier address rule is added so replies return to this order; this needs Inbox management access.
procurement_email_drafted: Draft saved. Open the Inbox to review it and request approval.
procurement_email_next_check: Next check after the verified send
procurement_incoming_note: Expected arrivals are separate from stock available to sell. Supplier orders and transfers count only while units remain outstanding.
procurement_incoming_unavailable: Incoming stock could not be read.
procurement_incoming_truncated: More arrivals exist. This bounded view does not show a complete total.
procurement_stock_note: Review the exact increase for undamaged received units. Approval is required. Stock is verified by a separate Shopify read.
procurement_stock_uncertain_note: Check the existing booking. Luma reads Shopify independently and does not send this write again.
procurement_stock_changed_note: Stock, receipt, mappings, authority or approval changed. Review a fresh proposal.
procurement_stock_native_note: Another member reviews the exact receipt and account balances. Undamaged units enter available stock; damaged units stay separate.
procurement_stock_owner_unavailable: Stock ownership could not be read. Refresh before booking this receipt.
procurement_stock_native_unverified: The current native balances could not independently verify this exact receipt posting. Check its entry and later stock movements.
procurement_shortfall_rounding: Draft quantity: {quantity} units after rounding to pack size {pack} and line minimum {minimum}.
procurement_incoming_supplier_unavailabl: Supplier arrivals are unavailable without purchasing read access. Transfers and native incoming stock remain separate evidence.
procurement_changes_note: Each change updates one position after approval and an independent purchasing-system read. Previous revisions and supplier commitments remain in history.
procurement_changes_unavailable: Order changes could not be loaded.
procurement_changes_no_support: This order cannot currently be revised through its purchasing connection. JTL supports structural changes only while its order is Open or Released.
procurement_changes_cancel_received: An order with received goods cannot be canceled.
procurement_changes_cancel_unsupported: The JTL-Wawi API does not support purchase-order cancellation. Arrange cancellation in your purchasing system before creating a replacement. Completing an order is not cancellation.
procurement_changes_commitments: This change affects supplier-confirmed or shipped units. Review the supplier commitment and give a reason before approval.
procurement_changes_form_note: Review one position. Changing confirmed or shipped quantities needs a reason. Unsupported changes stay unavailable; an uncertain write is checked without sending it again.
procurement_shortfall_effect: {sku}: current cover {current} days; estimated cover {after} days if the {quantity} outstanding units arrive. This uses the stated daily-demand assumption.
procurement_incoming_native_unavailable: Some supplier arrivals could not be established in the native incoming ledger. Review the receiving stock pool and purchasing evidence before using an incoming total.
procurement_timeline_note: Recorded decisions, provider observations and independent verification keep their own labels. A sent message or recorded receipt does not prove available stock changed.
procurement_timeline_truncated: Showing the latest 500 events. Earlier records remain in their source history.
procurement_timeline_restricted: Details of this stock booking, such as quantities, locations and who acted, need “{permission}”.
procurement_field_attention_description: What needs a response. A pending send approval shows in the stage instead.
procurement_field_stage_description: Where the order stands, from Luma’s records and the purchasing system. Luma works it out, so it can’t be changed here.
procurement_field_next_check_description: The earliest check time someone set while following up. A past time means the item needs attention again.
procurement_field_location_description: Matches when any line is delivered there.
procurement_field_sku_description: Matches when any line has this SKU.
procurement_field_value_description: Quantity × unit price over every line. Unknown when only some lines have a price or prices use different currencies.
procurement_field_confirmation_overdue_d: A sent order the supplier hasn’t confirmed in time.
procurement_group_empty: No purchase orders in this group.
procurement_list_unmatched_body: Try another search, view or condition.
procurement_waiting_proposals: {count, plural, one {{count, number} proposal waiting for approval} other {{count, number} proposals waiting for approval}}
procurement_list_orders_suppliers_ready: Your suppliers are ready. Create a draft order or review the proposals waiting for approval.
procurement_list_orders_checking_supplie: Create a draft order once the supplier directory has loaded.
procurement_submission_evidence: {count, plural, one {Submission evidence ({count, number} reference)} other {Submission evidence ({count, number} references)}}
